paragraphs.text: Ad'Amra was a human warrior and spellcaster from The Domains , known as the daughter of Red Donald . She played a key role in her father's military campaigns, participating in battles that spanned much of the Domains and witnessing the rise of powerful magical forces, including the Elder Dragons. Ad’Amra is remembered not only for her skill in blue magic but also for her tragic and unrequited love for Chromium Rhuell , a central figure in the Elder Dragons storyline.
She began to learn blue magic from Arcus of the High Council of Mors Ridge while her father's army camped there, including the Spell of Making. There, she fell in love with Ham of the council.

Ad'Amra became general of the Army of the Valley when Palladia-Mors was awakened and started the Battle at Mors Ridge . The town was attacked by a horde of orcs and undead, killing Red Donald . Ham revealed himself to be Palladia's brother, the Elder Dragon Chromium Rhuell . Ad'Amra used the Spell of Making to distract Palladia-Mors so that Chromium could cast a renewed stasis spell on his sister. Although Ham had turned out to be an Elder Dragon, Ad'Amra was hopelessly in love with him. Chromium said he could never love another again after Piru had been killed long ago. Ad'Amra left Mors and tracked Chromium across the Domains, eventually finding his lair. Again, he rejected her love and flew off across the skies, as Ad'Amra cried silently for her lost love.
